---
kind: guidance
title: Order findings by what they cost
requires:
- change-surface
---

Report the finding with the largest consequence first, not the one you found first.

Order by consequence, then by how certain you are. A reader stops partway
through, so the first finding is the one that has to survive being the only one
read.

State each finding as what breaks, under what input, with where in the change it
comes from.
